name: moodos-laptop-moodswing
description: MoodOS — Laptop MoodSwing System with real-time temperature, Wi-Fi monitoring, climate effects, and voice interaction.

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.desktop: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.app: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && electron electron/main.cjs"

author: Antigravity
